productStatement.question: ร้านยาแน่นที่สุดอยู่ตรงไหน และเป็นร้านแบบไหน

job: Screen and compare แขวง/ตำบล across Thailand by licensed-pharmacy density, store group, chains and the quality list before a location or territory decision, counting each licence once, with dataset · source · date · boundary on every number

audiences.label: ทีมขยายสาขาของเครือร้านยาและร้านสุขภาพ/ความงาม
ทีมขายและวางเขตของผู้ผลิต/ผู้จัดจำหน่ายยาและเวชภัณฑ์
นักวิเคราะห์ ที่ปรึกษา และหน่วยงานท้องถิ่น

journey: 3D first Aha (three densest แขวง of the leading province focused; benchmark the province; densest area outside it)
แขวง/ตำบล profile (groups, quality list, chains, list of pharmacies)
เขต/อำเภอ profile (incl. rows placed only at district level)
store detail (chain, licence, quality list, area and matching method, published point and role, source)
click a building in the focus (store · ร้านยาที่จุดตกในอาคารนี้)
click the next แขวง/ตำบล on the map (or its label) to move there
compare areas (density · group · quality list) and table
zoom out to the country: province frames by count; click to drill down
open the same area in CityMETER production

changesSince.base: CityMETER Restaurants 0.2.1 (same camera, basemap, massing, pictogram, breadcrumb and handoff contracts) and Luxury Brands 0.5

releases.0.1.1: live walk 2026-10-23 in the owner’s Chrome with real tiles: rounded focus massing in the first view (from zoom 12 when the focus tiles are complete; 16-tile bound nearest the camera), province view (a จังหวัด fits whole with its แขวง/ตำบล at every zoom; no count fill under it), closed top class printed like a density value, phone toolbar in one row (วิธีใช้ and Product statement in the sheet), number + unit never split, map status names the context figure as every point outside the focus

new: national scale: area index without geometry + per-province frames on demand
counting unit contract (licensed rows by default, every row optional, words follow the unit)
membership matched from administrative names at build time (row.admin recorded)
leading-province Aha with a province benchmark and the densest area outside it
geometric 1–2–5 classes for density and counts
measured zero from a national register (no no_data)
sparse published points (17%): areas never depend on pins
no venues, no logos, no x-ray (not collected in this research round)

scopeRows.definition: rows after search/group/quality/province/brand filters and the counting unit, before any area selection or area focus
consumers: area/district/store profiles (ranks keep the whole selection as reference)
quiet context dots (rows with a point)

baseRows.definition: scopeRows narrowed by the selected เขต/อำเภอ or แขวง/ตำบล
consumers: first Aha when a district is selected
counters and table when an area/district is selected

rows.definition: baseRows narrowed by the area focus (auto top-3 of the leading province, explicit ?areas=, or none with ?areas=all)
consumers: counters (labelled ในโฟกัส when narrowed)

buildingRows.definition: scopeRows whose published point falls inside the open building footprint (js/building-join.js#containsPoint); recomputed when the filters change

auto.focusIds: summarizeAreaInsight(...).areaIds (≤ 3, one province) when no area/district is selected

firstAha.scope: scopeRows, or baseRows when a เขต/อำเภอ is selected
firstAha.ranking: แขวง/ตำบล with ≥ 30 rows (MIN_AREA_ROWS), by rows per km² of the production area, then rows, then code; the leader’s province is the home; up to three best-ranked areas of the home
firstAha.headlineTemplate: {density} {ร้าน|รายการ}/ตร.กม. — ร้านยาแน่นที่สุดใน {areaCount} {แขวง|ตำบล|พื้นที่}นี้
firstAha.numerator: rows in the focused areas (matched membership)
firstAha.denominator: sum of their production km² (Σrows ÷ Σkm², never an average of ratios)
firstAha.baseline: rows of the home province in the selection ÷ the province’s production km²
firstAha.secondaryFinding: the best-ranked area outside the home province (hidden with a province filter)
firstAha.eligibilityCopy: นับร้านที่มีใบอนุญาต ขย1 ในทะเบียน อย. · จัดอันดับเฉพาะพื้นที่ที่มีอย่างน้อย 30 ร้าน
firstAha.defaultCamera: city preset, fitPitched over the focused areas (outline vertices when loaded, bbox corners before)
firstAha.action: ดูทุกพื้นที่ (?areas=all); เปรียบเทียบพื้นที่ (opens charts); area names are links
firstAha.explicitAction: โฟกัส {areaCount} {แขวง|ตำบล}นี้ (when focus mode is none)

names: คลองเตยเหนือ
defaultSnapshot.status: regression fixture — never a UI constant

fallbacks.noRows: ไม่พบร้านตามตัวกรองนี้ + นับทุกรายการ (licensed unit) + ล้างตัวกรอง
fallbacks.smallSelection: fewer than 1,000 rows or fewer than 3 eligible areas → count mode in the province holding the most placed rows: {share}% ของ{ร้าน|รายการ}ตามตัวกรองอยู่ใน 3 พื้นที่นี้
fallbacks.unplaced: no row placed at subdistrict level → “ยังระบุตำบลไม่ได้”
fallbacks.mapUnavailable: Aha, panel, charts and table stay usable; map failure card with retry

default.rule: rows with a ขย1 licence number of the FDA register snapshot; licence numbers are unique, so one licence = one premises
default.words: ร้าน · ร้าน/ตร.กม.

alternatives.rule: every row of 02_STORES (licensed + directory 3,384 + chain source 1,726); a storefront may appear more than once (1,221 cross-source pairs await identity review)
alternatives.words: รายการ · รายการ/ตร.กม.

countingUnitContract.words: js/model.js#unitWords(mode) → {one, density, densityLong, subject}; every label, legend, chart, panel and announcement uses it
countingUnitContract.rule: never mix units in one number; switching the unit recomputes the Aha, the classes and the focus; a row from another source opened from a list switches the unit to all (it is only in scope there)

areas.unit: ร้าน/ตร.กม. (รายการ/ตร.กม. in the all unit)
areas.classes: five geometric 1–2–5 classes over (0, observed max]: top break = largest ladder value ≤ max/3, each lower break = largest ladder value ≤ next/3; [lower, upper) with the last closed at the max; fewer classes when the range is narrow (evenly spread LDS class colours)

provinces.reason: the country view answers how many; a per-km² province value is dominated by forest and farmland

quality.metric: share of the area’s rows on the Pharmacy Council quality list (no validity dates)

eligibility.rationale: a density on a handful of rows is not a finding (random error ≈ 1/√n)

metricContract.combined: Σrows ÷ Σkm² for any set of areas

coverageContract.covered: the ขย1 register covers all 77 provinces; every frame is covered

states.measured_zero: no row under the filter — lowest class fill + 2 px dataState.zero outline; panel copy says “0 ตามแหล่งข้อมูล” with the register date (licensed unit) and offers the areas where the same filters match
states.no_data: treatment kept (135° hatch on dataState.noData + border.emphasis) for uncovered frames; unused in this release

coverageContract.unplaced: rows matched only to a district (74 licensed) or province (9 licensed) are counted there and never painted into a subdistrict; district and area panels say how many
coverageContract.points: a row without a published point has no pin and still counts in its area; panels show “มีพิกัดจากแหล่ง x/y”
coverageContract.legend: density classes + 0 (when present); province count classes below zoom 8 without a จังหวัด filter; the closed top bound prints like a density value (never below the densest label)

categoricalCueContract.registry: landometer-series-10-v8 (soft fill + ink per theme from assets/theme.css)
categoricalCueContract.bindBy: store group id (js/cues.js#GROUP_SERIES), stable through filtering and sorting

chain.th: เครือร้านยา

health_beauty.th: ร้านสุขภาพและความงาม

regional.th: เครือภูมิภาค/ท้องถิ่น

public.th: ร้านยาของรัฐและสถาบัน

independent.th: ร้านยาท้องถิ่น/ยังไม่ยืนยันเครือ

uses: map symbol layer (cue icon = series fill + shape, marker-stroke outline)
legend “ประเภทร้าน (สีและรูปทรง)”
categoricalCueContract.rationale: the dominant independent group (≈ 92% of licensed rows) takes the open ring so chains read as filled shapes; no star (it would read as a rating)

framesContract.index: data/area-index.json — 77 provinces, 928 districts, 7,436 subdistricts: names, production codes, areaSqm, label point, bbox; no geometry (js/areas.js#buildAreaIndex)
framesContract.frames: data/frames/{CODE}.json per province: {metadata, areas: FeatureCollection, districts: FeatureCollection} (subdistricts simplified once nationally at 30 m, districts dissolved)
framesContract.loading: js/frames.js#createFrameStore: ensure(code) idempotent, concurrency 2, versioned with the release tag; app.js loads the provinces the selection needs (filter, area, district, focus, store) and, after each camera move at zoom ≥ 7.5, up to 6 provinces under the map nearest its centre (js/frames.js#provinceLocator on data/provinces.geojson)
framesContract.attach: each outline is attached to its index record (feature); the merged FeatureCollections are re-set on the area sources (setFrames) and every feature-state is re-applied
framesContract.failure: a failed or invalid frame file is reported (console + map-status data attribute), never cached, retried on the next request; ranks, panels, charts and table never depend on frames

mapFocusContract.principle: Show detail only for the focused part; keep everything else quiet (carried over from Luxury Brands, owner 2026-10-22)

overviewAuto.focus: top areas of the leading province: density fill, ink label chips with value and class swatch, cue symbols (rows with a point), rounded focus massing (3D from zoom 12 when the focus tiles are complete, else 13)
overviewAuto.quiet: other frames outline-only, light label chips from zoom 11 (≤ 12 desktop, none on a phone); rows outside the focus are grey context dots; city massing quiet

overviewAll.focus: every frame filled by density class; up to 30 labels (10 on a phone) from zoom 11

district.focus: the district’s แขวง/ตำบล filled, district outline selected, their labels from zoom 9.5

area.focus: selected frame fill below zoom 14.5, selected outline, cue symbols, HTML pins from zoom 15.5; every focus building is clickable
area.quiet: other frames outline-only with label chips at a visible point for every frame on screen (≤ 16 desktop, ≤ 4 phone)

store.focus: selected ring, desktop popup, the building its point falls in drawn in map.activeLayer; massing focus = the store’s area + 250 m around its point

building.focus: the clicked building in map.activeLayer and the rows whose points fall inside it
building.quiet: everything else; the camera stays where the user clicked

country.focus: without a จังหวัด filter: province frames filled by count below zoom 8, ink chips with counts; ทั้งประเทศ clears the จังหวัด filter and the focus (?areas=all)

provinceView.focus: with a จังหวัด filter (0.1.1): the province is fitted whole and its แขวง/ตำบล are drawn at every zoom from 4 (feature-state province on the area layers); its focus/selected labels show from that zoom; the legend is the density classes; a click inside it opens the แขวง/ตำบล at any zoom
provinceView.quiet: no province is count-filled; other provinces are outlines with quiet chips and stay clickable below zoom 8 (another จังหวัด)

autoReleased.focus: national-scale adaptation: while no area of the AUTOMATIC focus is on screen, every loaded frame is filled (js/app.js#mapFocusIds, re-checked after each camera move); the panel keeps the Aha; explicit focus, a selected area or a district never release

mapFocusContract.choropleth: density.area classes, opacity 1 beneath the basemap’s first line layer, zoom 8–14.5 (the selected จังหวัด from zoom 4), hard switch off at 14.5, EVID-05 states per coverageContract
mapFocusContract.symbols: symbol layer of cue icons for focus rows with a point above a grey circle layer of the whole scope’s points (context: not focusable, not clickable, sent only when the filters change)
mapFocusContract.labels: HTML chips collision-managed against each other and the map chrome; area chips from zoom 8 (focus; from 4 in the province view) / 11 (quiet), province chips below zoom 9

buildingJoinContract.buildings: focus-tier OSM footprints kept by js/massing.js before rounding/offset (stable ids focusFeatureId(tile, polygon ordinal in the tile))
buildingJoinContract.points: published source points (17% of rows); rows without one never join
buildingJoinContract.rule: a row joins the smallest drawn footprint containing its point (holes excluded); bbox grid index; recomputed when the focus tier or the filters change

click.building: several points → building panel ร้านยาที่จุดตกในอาคารนี้

buildingJoinContract.highlight: the open building, or the building the open store’s point falls in, moves to the massing venue tier in map.activeLayer
buildingJoinContract.copy: จุดตกในอาคาร (never ตั้งอยู่ใน); no floor or unit
neverChanges: any count outside the building panel

clickOrder: below zoom 8: a แขวง/ตำบล of the selected จังหวัด (province view), else a province frame of another จังหวัด
แขวง/ตำบล via area-hit at every zoom ≥ 8
interactionContract.sameArea: a click inside the selected area changes nothing (pan and tilt freely)
interactionContract.otherProvince: selecting an area or district in another province moves the จังหวัด filter with it
interactionContract.contextDots: never click targets: a click in the quiet context selects the area underneath
interactionContract.hover: pointer over anything clickable; a thin map.selectedStroke outline on the area a click would open
smoothMoves: update() reuses scopeRows and the area model while the filters are unchanged

basemapContract.generator: js/map-style.js#buildMapStyle(theme, {palette, tileJSON, glyphs}) — a MapLibre style v8 object built at runtime; no hosted style URL

tiles.buildingLayer: building (fields render_height, render_min_height, hide_3d; available z13–14)
tiles.labels: name:th preferred, then name; no POI, housenumber or boundary labels

palette.source: assets/theme.css --basemap-* tokens (light and dark declared once each; basemap-only, not data colours)

layerOrder: massing (city + focus tiers, open building in map.activeLayer) (inserted before MASSING_BEFORE = water-name, the first symbol layer)
basemapContract.atmosphere: sky + fog blend the far ground into the paper colour; viewport-anchored light (#FFFFFF, intensity 0.32) gives massing a soft shade; both are quiet context, never data
basemapContract.themeSwitch: map.setStyle(buildMapStyle(theme)) then re-install spatial layers; data layers keep the same HEX on both themes

massingContract.module: js/massing.js#installMassing(map, {sourceId, beforeId, colors, tileUrl, fetchImpl}) → {update, retheme, dispose, layerIds}

cityTier.layer: city-massing (fill-extrusion, source openmaptiles, source-layer building, minzoom 13)
cityTier.height: render_height / render_min_height from the tile; hide_3d features excluded
cityTier.filter: ['all', ['!=', ['get','hide_3d'], true]] (no host twins to hide in this product)

focusTier.source: focus-massing (GeoJSON built from the same tile URLs MapLibre loads, decoded by js/mvt.js; z14, ≤ 16 tiles per update (MAX_TILES), tiles touching the focus regions; over the bound the tiles nearest the camera centre, planned again after each move)
focusTier.layer: focus-massing-3d (fill-extrusion): from zoom 12 (FOCUS_MIN_ZOOM) in 3D when every tile of the focus is loaded — the national first Aha frames three แขวง at z12.6 and needs 11 tiles — else from zoom 13 (CITY_MIN_ZOOM, also in plan view); the city tier needs 13 (no buildings in lower basemap tiles)
focusTier.selection: buildings overlapping a focus polygon (the selected area, the auto/explicit focus, or the open store’s area plus a 250 m square around its point), clipped to the tile box with buffer
focusTier.shape: js/geometry.js: cleanRing → clipRingToBox → offsetRing(+d) → roundRing(r, 3 segments, encloseOffset d)
focusTier.visibility: 3D and plan (plan shows the rounded footprints flat)
focusTier.cacheKey: regions + hosts + zoom bucket (full zoom level) + 3D on/off + the planned tile list + tile availability

massingContract.hostTier: not used — no host buildings were collected; the open building (or the building of the open store) moves to the massing venue tier (focus-massing-venue) in map.activeLayer

rounding.radiusMetres: roundingRadiusM(zoom, lat) = clamp(4 px in metres at max(zoom, 14.5), 3, 12)
rounding.reference: maplibre/maplibre-style-spec#1047 (polygon corner radius) is unsupported in MapLibre; rounding is done in geometry, display only

enclosure.radiusCap: radius ≤ 0.95 · d / (1 − sin(θ/2)) so the rounded ring still encloses the original polygon at every corner
enclosure.purpose: the quiet city twin stays fully inside the rounded focus solid → no z-fighting without hiding it; host twins are hidden instead because the host solid is the data layer

massingContract.provenance: building heights and footprints are OSM via OpenFreeMap (defaults when no height tag); context only, never a claim of this dataset; OpenFreeMap merges same-height buildings into MultiPolygons, so single roofs cannot be picked

scene.note: the eye scene and occluders are carried in the module but unused (no venue level in this product)

distanceFade.rule: city-tier colour interpolates from --basemap-massing-quiet (fade 0) to --basemap-ground (fade 1, invisible) by distance from the nearest focus anchor (area centroid; every area when nothing is focused)
distanceFade.mechanism: feature-state `fade` written once per building id after tiles load (querySourceFeatures on sourcedata/moveend); anchors change → states rebuilt
distanceFade.why: MapLibre has no camera-distance expression and fill-extrusion-opacity is not data-driven

cameraContract.module: js/camera.js (CAMERA, presetFor, applyPreset, fitPitched, framePoint, shiftPadding)

plan.when: view3d off (3D toggle / ?view3d=0), bounds wider than 0.3°, the country view and province frames

model.when: แขวง/ตำบล, store and building in 3D — near-axonometric, verticals upright

fitting.function: fitPitched(map, bounds, {preset, padding, maxZoom 16, minZoom 10, points, shift})
fitting.method: start from cameraForBounds (flat), apply preset pitch/bearing/FOV, zoom out in 0.1 steps until every point (polygon vertices when given, else bbox corners) projects inside the padded viewport, then zoom in while they still fit; jumps are computed without rendering and the final camera is animated
fitting.padding: desktop 3D padding ignores the legend; mobile portrait with the sheet open uses plan, then re-frames in 3D on sheet close
fitting.bearing: 28° so the Siam → Chit Lom → Phrom Phong axis runs left-to-right on wide screens
fitting.แขวง/ตำบล: fitRecord: fitPitched over the outline vertices when the province frame is loaded, else the index bbox corners (works before the outline arrives), maxZoom 17.5
fitting.province: plan fit of the whole province bbox, no zoom floor (0.1.1): the selected province draws its แขวง/ตำบล at every zoom from 4 (mapFocusContract.states.provinceView); 0.1.0 held the fit at zoom 8.05 and cut 25 of 77 provinces at 1440×813 (Chiang Mai fits at 6.8)
fitting.country: ทั้งประเทศ: plan fit of the union of the 77 province boxes, maxZoom 7

maplibre.requires: setVerticalFieldOfView (≥ 4.7), maxPitch 85; keep pitch ≤ 90 − fov/2 − 3 for any fill-extrusion view
maplibre.orthographic: not available in MapLibre; narrow FOV is the standard substitute

cameraContract.alternatives: deck.gl custom projectionMatrix or three.js camera.setViewOffset give a true two-point camera; not adopted to keep a single MapLibre scene

data.rowGrain: one row of 02_STORES (source-qualified outlet candidate after the sheet’s merge rules); never merged, split or moved here
data.core: data/pharmacies.json (columnar; meta, groups, brands, sources, urls, vocab, provinces, districts, areas, cols, points)
data.areas: data/area-index.json (7,436 / 928 / 77, no geometry), data/frames/{CODE}.json (77 files), data/provinces.geojson (77), data/boundary-receipts.json (7,514 receipts)

data.pointPolicy: published source points only, inside Thailand’s box, 6 decimals, role kept; never geocoded or invented

visualSystem.appliedTokens: assets/theme.css (foundation pairs, semantic states, map roles, dataState, series 1–10, count classes, basemap-only tokens)

analyticalScales.themePolicy: identical light HEX on both themes

visualSystem.parity: scripts/check-lds-parity.mjs: 130 checks against the LDS source file

locationProfile.reason: licensed premises in a register are not a supply-capacity, demand, access or market measure

visualSystem.reportedDifference: dark no-data/zero colours differ between the analytical scale records (#3B4849 / #BAC6C0) and machine.tokens.dataState (#404844 / #93A398); the EVID-05 treatments reference dataState, which the map uses

invariants.rule: One row with a published point owns one symbol; no clustering or aggregation, including quiet context dots
Membership is the production code matched at build time from the row’s own administrative names (row.admin); never re-assign by point-in-polygon on display coordinates or by name at runtime
Density = rows ÷ production km²; combined density Σrows ÷ Σkm²; never average ratios
Never rank by density below MIN_AREA_ROWS (30); small selections switch to counts and say so
Counting unit: licensed rows by default (one ขย1 licence = one premises); every row only with ?count=all and the word “รายการ”; never mix units in one number
Missing is never zero and never invented: no point → no pin but still counted; zero in the register = measured_zero with the register date; no geocoding
Every panel view ends with dataset · source · date · boundary and what one unit is
The licence status is not an opening check and the quality list has no validity dates — never claimed otherwise
Chains are the sheet’s approved banners only; candidates show “ยังไม่ยืนยัน”; other rows of the same chain in the same area are “อาจเป็นร้านเดียวกัน”, never “สาขาเดียวกัน”
Analytical colours are exact LDS LUT values, identical on both themes; categorical colours keep their shape cue
The first paint is the 3D city preset with the auto focus in the leading province; numbers never change with the camera
scopeRows drive the Aha, choropleth and charts; rows drive symbols with detail, counters and table
Province frames use counts, not density
Breadcrumb levels and deep links follow production codes; a store is never a crumb; a selection in another province moves the จังหวัด filter
Only the open building (or the open store’s building) carries the data colour
Matrix cells are equal in size; the quality share is of the area’s rows
Core value (Aha, panel, charts, table) works without the map and without frame files
No private Drive/Sheet URLs, credentials, internal sheet, phone numbers, addresses, notes or the full LDS library in the repository
Map attribution (OpenStreetMap, OpenMapTiles/OpenFreeMap, CityMETER) stays readable above the charts tray; the legend, the phone Aha card and area labels keep clear of it
A measured non-zero density never prints as 0 (one shared format: 1 decimal ≥ 1, 2 below 1, 3 below 0.1, “<0.001” below that) on labels, panel and charts
The building join is display-time only: published points × drawn footprints, said as “จุดตกในอาคาร”; it never changes any count

Map clicks follow interactionContract.clickOrder; another แขวง/ตำบล is clickable from zoom 8 (inside the selected จังหวัด at any zoom); a click inside the selected area changes nothing; quiet context dots are never targets
Frames load on demand (the selection + ≤ 6 provinces under the map at subdistrict zoom); never all 77 up front; a failed load is retried, never cached
A selection never re-sends the context points or shapes massing during a camera move; pins only follow the map while it moves
